description: This Swift source file contains definitions and implementations related to locating and validating a runtime environment, specifically the Node runtime, for an application called OpenClaw. It includes enums, structs, error handling, and logic to find the Node executable, read its version, and ensure it meets minimum requirements.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the runtime by searching given paths for the Node executable, reading its version, and validating it against minimum requirements.

methods.name: describeFailure
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description of errors encountered during runtime resolution.

methods.name: findExecutable
methods.description: Searches through provided directories to locate an executable file by name.

methods.name: readVersion
methods.description: Executes the binary with '--version' argument to obtain its version string.
